description: Use for a pull request or a diff of an app that has no saved project; to price a change against the accepted project, use price_change. Reads only; no sign-in. What a code change does to an app's bill: pass the files before (base_files) and after (head_files) the change, such as package.json, requirements.txt, .env.example (names only) and deploy configs. Returns the services added and removed, each priced now and in 12 months at the given users, with cheaper options and cost jumps, the change in monthly cost, and comment_markdown ready to post on a pull request. Use it before adding a paid service or SDK, or to review a pull request. Rules only; nothing is stored.

mau_now.description: Monthly active users today. Default 1,000, and the comment says it was assumed.

plans.description: Plans the app is on, when known.

capability.description: Capability id from list_capabilities, e.g. auth.saml_sso.

source.description: The PRD sentence this came from.

name: diff_stack

assumptions.description: Usage and pricing assumptions behind the numbers.

caveats.description: Show to the user word for word.

completeness.description: On plan and project results: complete, complete_with_assumptions, incomplete or needs_clarification, with the reasons. Say plainly when it is not complete.

data.description: The tool result. Its shape depends on the tool.

disclosures.description: Always includes the neutrality note: no vendor pays for a place in the answer. Link its url when you mention how Kong Reviews is paid.

project.description: On results about a saved project: its id and the context version the answer was computed on. Pass both back in follow-up calls.

title: Price a code change (pull request)
